node.title: TK + Script
node.author: Ggavazzo
node.doctext:
Wise Monks;
I have hundreds of perl scripts that are executed via command, for a better use of users, I built a screen for windows in tk. I would like to make a screen where the user searches for the file, search for a certain script to run. The output of the file will be in the same folder as the original file.
